name: chatWhatsapp
title: Chat Whatsapp
description: Short synthetic WhatsApp-style conversation when the product story is naturally conversational or customer-service oriented. Use sparingly because it is long.

vanillasky.useWhen: Short synthetic WhatsApp-style conversation when the product story is naturally conversational or customer-service oriented. Use sparingly because it is long.

msg1.label: Message 1 (received)
msg1.description: First message — left/received by default. Append |in or |out to override side. Aim for 3-4 messages total (most common). Use 5 with date chips only when narrative spans days AND scene is 10s+.

msg2.label: Message 2 (received or sent)
msg2.default: It saves me hours every week
msg2.description: Second message — left/received by default. Override with |out for ping-pong.

msg3.label: Message 3 (received)
msg3.description: Third message — left/received by default. Skip (leave blank) for a 2-message exchange.

msg4.label: Message 4 (sent)
msg4.description: Fourth message — right/sent by default. Optional. Most chats end here on the reply.

dateChip1.label: Date chip 1
dateChip1.description: Optional date label between message 3 and message 4 (e.g. 'Monday'). Use only when the conversation explicitly spans a real time gap. Leave blank otherwise.

dateChip2.label: Date chip 2
dateChip2.description: Optional date label between message 4 and message 5 (e.g. 'Yesterday'). Same rule as dateChip1.

msg5.label: Message 5 (sent)
msg5.description: Fifth message — right/sent by default. Optional. Use only for the 5-message + chips 'spans days' pattern.

defaultVariables.msg2: It saves me hours every week
